title: Six Christmas decor themes, and the pieces to pull each one off
dek: Gold, champagne, classic red and green, white, candy-colourful or proudly Filipino: pick a theme, then shop the four pieces that build it in a small condo corner.
teaser: Gold, champagne, red and green, white, candy or Filipino: four pieces for each theme.
description: Christmas decor theme ideas for Filipino homes, each with four products: gold, champagne and blush, red and green, white Christmas, candy and colourful, and Filipino capiz and parols.

hero.alt: AI sample render of six small Christmas vignettes side by side in gold, champagne and blush, red and green, white, candy pastels and a Filipino capiz-and-abaca corner
hero.caption: AI sample render of the six themes, drawn from written descriptions of our picks. The real product photos from Lazada are below.

intro: The easiest way to make Christmas decor look intentional is to choose a theme and repeat it. A short list of colours and materials, used again and again, makes even a tiny sala look planned rather than busy.

Below are six themes, each built as one small-condo corner of four pieces you can buy now, in good materials like glass, wood, ceramic, velvet, felt and handwoven textiles wherever we could find them.

curation.title: One colour story per corner
summary: Design editors agree a Christmas scheme should start with a short colour list and repeat it: gold works alone or softened with white or blush, red and green look richest in deep berry and forest shades with a metallic accent, and one colour in mixed finishes looks more expensive than many colours. We built each theme as one small-condo corner of four different pieces, favouring glass, wood, ceramic, velvet, felt and handwoven textiles over plain plastic.
steps: Read design editors on Christmas colour schemes and noted what makes each palette work.
Planned each theme as one small-condo corner with four different kinds of piece: a tree, ornaments, light or greenery, and a textile or centrepiece.
Compared Lazada listings per slot, favouring glass, wood, ceramic and handwoven pieces over plain plastic.
Checked every product photo and variant for colour fit and for religious imagery, and kept lights to USB, battery, solar or certified options.

sections.name: Gold Christmas
sections.alt: AI sample render of a small condo corner styled in the Gold Christmas theme with the picks below
sections.definition: A gold Christmas works because one warm metal, repeated in shiny, matte and glitter finishes, looks rich and calm instead of busy. Keep the tree's green as the only other colour and light it all in warm white, and it reads more modern than red and green.
tips: Mix finishes, not colours: shiny, matte and glitter gold side by side look richer than one finish.
Pile gold balls in a clear bowl on the sala table; it glimmers without blocking anyone's view.
Use warm-white lights only. Cool white makes gold look grey and flat.

items.label: Easiest gold tree
items.name: HOUSENSE 60 cm Gold Mini Christmas Tree Full Set
items.verdict: A 60 cm tree that arrives already dressed in gold, so a console or side table is done in one box.
items.summary: The photo shows a compact green pine in a deep-red box pot, hung with gold and champagne balls, gold hearts, bells, a big gold bow and a star. It is sold as a full set, so you skip buying trims one by one, and it fits a console or shelf.

reviewers.point: Interior designer Jonathan Adler, quoted by Homes & Gardens, calls gold "more modern than red and green", and a decorating expert suggests pairing gold with white or blush pink.
reviewers.source: Homes & Gardens: Christmas color schemes, 9 seasonal palettes (Zara Stacey, updated 29 Oct 2024)

reviewers.point: Keep the tree at least 3 feet (about 1 m) from heat sources such as heaters and candles, and make sure it doesn't block an exit.
reviewers.source: U.S. Fire Administration: Holiday fire safety

reviewers.point: The photo shows tiny lights on the tree. Turn off all light strings and decorations before leaving home or going to bed.
reviewers.source: NFPA: Winter Holiday Safety tip sheet

Branded set from the Gmarket Korea store

reviewers.point: A Neptune stylist quoted by Livingetc says adding foliage gives a tree more texture and makes it feel fuller, and to add it last, once lights and baubles are in place.

Doubles as a no-water vase arrangement

Looks best mixed with real wood or linen textures

items.label: Best plug-in lights
items.name: Fuji Bright 100-LED Warm White String Lights

reviewers.point: The BFP and DTI advise buying only quality Christmas lights with Philippine Standard (PS) and ICC marks, and turning them off in the wee hours.

reviewers.point: Replace any light string with worn or broken cords or loose bulbs, and follow the maker's limit on how many strands to connect.
reviewers.source: NFPA: Winter Holiday Safety tip sheet

Warm white flatters gold; only 10 bulbs strobe
About 8.5 m covers a small tree and a shelf
cons: Plug-in, so place it near an outlet
Includes white strobe bulbs for extra twinkle

items.tip: Check for the ICC sticker when it arrives, plug it straight into the wall (no octopus wiring) and switch it off at bedtime.

alt.name: Twinkle Star 12-Star LED Curtain Lights (warm white)
alt.label: Window star lights
alt.note: About ₱299. Twelve hanging star strands for a window, in warm white. Confirm the power type on the listing: choose a battery version, or a plug-in one only if it shows an ICC sticker.

sections.name: Champagne and blush Christmas
sections.alt: AI sample render of a small condo corner styled in the Champagne and blush Christmas theme with the picks below
sections.definition: Champagne and blush pairs soft pink with pale, pinkish gold, so the metal warms the pink and the pink softens the shine. Snowy flocking, clear glass and a handwoven texture keep it grown-up and cosy rather than sugary.
tips: Let the tree carry the pink and keep ornaments in rose gold and champagne, so the corner reads soft, not candy.
Mix shiny, matte and glitter balls of one colour for depth without adding more colours.
Add one natural texture, like a handwoven runner, so the pastels feel lived-in.

items.label: Best blush tree
items.name: Great-King Pink Flocked Slim Pencil Christmas Tree
items.verdict: A narrow pink pencil tree dusted with white flocking: tall enough to feel grand, slim enough for a condo corner.
items.summary: A pencil tree takes about the floor space of a side table, and small-room advice favours a taller, slimmer tree that draws the eye up. Pink branches with white snowy tips give the blush look on their own, so the ornaments can stay simple.

reviewers.point: Designer Marie Flanigan, quoted by Livingetc, suggests a taller, slimmer tree that draws the eye upward without crowding the floor, placed in a corner or near a window.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: How Can I Fit a Christmas Tree in a Small Living Room?

reviewers.point: Homes & Gardens suggests going all out with a pink faux Christmas tree for a bright scheme, and a decorating expert pairs blush pink with gold for a softer look.
reviewers.source: Homes & Gardens: Christmas color schemes, 9 seasonal palettes (Zara Stacey, updated 29 Oct 2024)

reviewers.point: Keep the tree at least 3 feet (about 1 m) from heat sources and make sure it doesn't block an exit.
reviewers.source: U.S. Fire Administration: Holiday fire safety

pros: Slim shape saves floor space in a condo
Pink and snow-white built in, so few trims needed
From Great-King's own store, a known tree brand
cons: A floor-standing size, made for a corner
Fluff gently; a little flocking may fall at first
items.bestFor: A blush corner with a real tree that still leaves room to walk
items.tip: Fluff every branch tip outward before decorating, and keep it about 1 m from lamps, the stove and other heat sources.

items.summary: One colour in shiny, matte and glitter finishes is the easiest way to make a tree look styled, and rose gold bridges the pink tree and the champagne accents. Twenty pieces cover a slim tree, with a few left for a bowl or the side table.

reviewers.point: Paint expert Annie Sloan, quoted by Livingetc, says baubles in one statement colour look "terribly expensive" on a tree.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: Christmas tree ideas, design experts on how to decorate like a pro (Amy Neason, updated 28 Oct 2022)

reviewers.point: A decorating expert quoted by Homes & Gardens suggests pairing gold with blush pinks for a feminine, whimsical look.
reviewers.source: Homes & Gardens: Christmas color schemes, 9 seasonal palettes (Zara Stacey, updated 29 Oct 2024)

pros: 20 balls dress a slim tree in one go

Comes in a clear tube for easy storage

items.tip: Hang matte balls deeper in the branches and shiny ones near the tips, so the light bounces from the outside in.

reviewers.point: Odd numbers look natural: group three trees of different heights rather than a matching row.
Keep faux-snow trees away from candles and heat, and dust them with a soft dry brush.

items.label: Best candle glow
items.name: Cutora Clear Glass Globe Tealight Holder
items.verdict: A clear glass sphere with a tealight cup on top: simple, affordable and lovely next to rose gold.
items.summary: Clear glass picks up the blush and gold around it instead of adding a new colour, and candlelight makes rose-gold balls shimmer. In a condo, a battery LED tealight gives the same glow without an open flame near the tree.

reviewers.point: Keep candles at least 12 inches (30 cm) from anything that burns, in stable holders that can't be knocked over, and consider battery-operated flameless candles.

reviewers.point: Blow out lit candles when you leave the room or go to bed, and keep children and pets away from them.

sections.name: Classic red and green
sections.alt: AI sample render of a small condo corner styled in the Classic red and green theme with the picks below
sections.definition: Classic red and green borrows straight from nature, berry red against deep forest green, which is why it feels nostalgic and cosy. Deep shades, real textures like velvet, ceramic and greenery, and a little warm light keep it rich instead of loud.
tips: Choose deep berry reds and forest greens over bright primary shades for a richer look.
Add one metallic, gold or silver, as a small accent so the pair looks finished.
Repeat each colour in three places around the corner: tree, shelf and sofa.

items.label: Best basic tree

items.verdict: A plain, full 2 ft green tree on a metal stand: the blank canvas a red-and-green corner needs.
items.summary: It comes from 2 ft up, in green or white, and the 2 ft green fits a TV console or shoe cabinet. Raise it on a stool or crate for height, then let the berries, ceramics and velvet bring in the red.

reviewers.point: Designer Marie Flanigan, quoted by Livingetc, warns that a tree that's too small can make a small room feel even smaller. Raising a 2 ft tree on a stool or console gives it more presence.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: How Can I Fit a Christmas Tree in a Small Living Room?

reviewers.point: Keep the tree at least 3 feet (about 1 m) from heat sources and make sure it doesn't block an exit.
reviewers.source: U.S. Fire Administration: Holiday fire safety

pros: Popular with recent buyers

₱418 is likely the smallest size; taller ones cost more

items.tip: Choose 2 ft green, fluff every tip outward, and set it on a sturdy stool or crate so it sits closer to eye level.

items.summary: Condos rarely have a mantel, but a floating shelf or mirror frame does the same job. This vine brings both colours of the palette at once, and the lit version in the photo has a small battery box with a timer, so no extra plug.

reviewers.point: Livingetc's small-space ideas include a garland of greenery along the mantel, or a lit garland with sprigs of holly, instead of a big tree.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: 6 Christmas Tree Alternatives for Small Spaces (8 Dec 2023)

reviewers.point: Half of decoration fires happen because decorations are placed too close to a heat source, so keep the garland away from lamps and the kitchen.
reviewers.source: NFPA: Winter Holiday Safety tip sheet

reviewers.point: Don't mix old and new batteries, or different types or makes, because this can cause leakage or rupture.
reviewers.source: Energizer: Battery care do's and don'ts

items.summary: Glazed ceramic in red, green and white has the feel of vintage holiday pieces, and the cut-out stars cast little points of light. One figure on the console beside the tree is enough, and it doubles as a gift for a tita or ninang.

reviewers.point: Homes & Gardens says red, green and gold decorations create a scheme rich in nostalgic character, cosy charm and Christmas tradition.
reviewers.source: Homes & Gardens: Christmas color schemes, 9 seasonal palettes (Zara Stacey, updated 29 Oct 2024)

reviewers.point: If you light it with a candle, consider a battery-operated flameless candle instead; they can look and feel like the real thing.
reviewers.source: U.S. Fire Administration: Holiday fire safety

sections.name: White Christmas
sections.alt: AI sample render of a small condo corner styled in the White Christmas theme with the picks below
sections.definition: A white Christmas layers white, cream, frost and clear light so the corner looks like fresh snow without a strong colour. It suits a condo because the quiet palette sits easily with neutral walls, and texture from flocking, fibre and pine keeps it from looking flat.
tips: Layer several whites and creams; one flat white looks cold.
Get interest from texture: flocking, natural fibre, frosted needles and pinecones.
Choose warm-white lights for a cosy glow, or white for a crisper, icier look.

items.label: Best mini white tree

items.summary: White-tipped needles give the snowy look of a flocked tree at desk size, and the wood-slice base adds a natural touch. Group it with the frosted swag and cream star for a little winter scene on a console or bookshelf.

reviewers.point: A Bloom & Wild director quoted by Livingetc says tiny trees bring festive magic to a smaller space or cosy corner, and Livingetc suggests a white, snow-sprayed tree for a different look.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: Christmas tree ideas, design experts on how to decorate like a pro (Amy Neason, updated 28 Oct 2022)

reviewers.point: Livingetc's deputy editor recommends little Christmas vignettes around the home when there's no mantel or staircase to decorate.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: 6 Christmas Tree Alternatives for Small Spaces (8 Dec 2023)

cons: Pick the frosted option; a green version is also sold
Fluff the long needles after unboxing for a full look
items.bestFor: Framing a mirror, doorway or blank wall in a small unit
items.tip: Hang one on each side of a mirror with adhesive hooks, and weave the USB fairy lights through the needles.

sections.name: Candy and colourful
sections.alt: AI sample render of a small condo corner styled in the Candy and colourful theme with the picks below
sections.definition: Candy and colourful borrows from the sweet shop: peppermint red and white with pastel mint, pink and lilac. It works when playful shapes like nutcrackers, candy canes and pom-poms share a short colour list, so the corner looks joyful rather than random.
tips: Pick four or five candy colours and repeat them; leave out anything off the list.
Mix textures, wood, felt, yarn and pom-poms, so it feels handmade, not plastic.
Keep the background calm, a white wall or plain shelf, so the colours pop.

items.label: Most creative pick
items.name: MANYING Pastel Wooden Nutcracker Ornaments, Set of 4
items.verdict: Four pastel wooden nutcrackers holding lollipops and candy: the star of a candy-coloured shelf.
items.summary: Mint, pink, lilac and sky-blue soldiers with candy details give the classic nutcracker a sweet-shop twist. They stand on a shelf or hang from the tree by their cords, and painted wood feels far nicer in the hand than plastic figures.

reviewers.point: Designers Guild founder Tricia Guild, quoted by Livingetc: "Christmas is such a happy time - so use the colors that you love."
reviewers.source: Livingetc: Christmas tree ideas, design experts on how to decorate like a pro (Amy Neason, updated 28 Oct 2022)

reviewers.point: Interior designer Irene Gunter, quoted by Livingetc, has decorated for years with hand-painted, carved wooden pieces inherited from her parents.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: Christmas tree ideas, design experts on how to decorate like a pro (Amy Neason, updated 28 Oct 2022)

pros: Painted wood, not plastic
Stand on a shelf or hang on the tree
Four pastel colours in one set
cons: Petite figures; check the height first
Pick the pastel set from the colour options
items.bestFor: A playful shelf display that moves to the tree on Christmas Eve
items.tip: Line them up on a shelf in colour order with the pom-pom lights behind, then move them to the tree on Christmas Eve.

items.label: Best candy accent
items.name: Three-D Mania Fuzzy Candy Cane Ornament
items.verdict: Soft, yarn-textured red-and-white candy canes that hook over a shelf edge, a mug or a branch.
items.summary: The fuzzy, textured stripes look handmade and give the classic candy cane a cosy, tactile finish. Hook them over the front of a floating shelf, a mug rim or tree branches; the hook shape means no extra hangers.

reviewers.point: Livingetc's deputy editor recommends little Christmas vignettes around the home when there's no mantel or staircase to decorate.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: 6 Christmas Tree Alternatives for Small Spaces (8 Dec 2023)

reviewers.point: These look like sweets but aren't edible, so keep them out of reach of toddlers and pets.

pros: Textured wrap looks handmade
Hook shape hangs anywhere, no hangers needed
Classic red and white anchors the palette
cons: Check the pack count in the options
Looks like real candy, so hang it above little hands
items.bestFor: Shelf edges, mugs and tree branches in a candy corner
items.tip: Hang three over a shelf edge at slightly different heights, with the stripes spiralling the same way.

items.label: Best kid-friendly
items.name: Nuvox Felt Christmas Ornament Set
items.verdict: Soft felt Santa, snowman, reindeer, tree, candy cane and snowflake ornaments that won't break if they fall.
items.summary: Fabric ornaments suit homes where kids or pets visit, and the cheerful felt adds the homemade feel a candy theme needs. Hang them on the low branches or along a ribbon, and keep the wooden and glass pieces higher up.

reviewers.point: Homes & Gardens describes a tree with colourful ribbons and kitsch felt ornaments that felt joyful and layered, like a nostalgic movie set.
reviewers.source: Homes & Gardens: 9 beautiful Christmas tree ideas (Charlotte Olby, 7 Nov 2025)

reviewers.point: Designers Guild founder Tricia Guild, quoted by Livingetc, says to use the colours you love at Christmas.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: Christmas tree ideas, design experts on how to decorate like a pro (Amy Neason, updated 28 Oct 2022)

pros: Soft fabric won't shatter on low branches
Six cheerful designs in one set (photo)
From the Nuvox Home store
cons: Playful cartoon faces, best for a fun theme
Bright red and green; mix in a few pastels
items.bestFor: Low branches and homes with little kids or pets
items.tip: Hang these on the lower branches or along a ribbon, and keep glass or wooden ornaments higher up.

items.label: Best playful lights
items.name: Sanwood Pom-Pom Fairy Lights, Battery (pink and white)
items.verdict: Pink and white pom-poms strung between crystal-petal LEDs: soft, playful light that runs on batteries.
items.summary: The fluffy pom-poms add a softness ordinary fairy lights don't have, and the pink-and-white mix sits right in a candy palette. Battery power means you can drape it over a shelf or headboard with no outlet nearby.

reviewers.point: Remove all batteries at the same time and replace them with new ones of the same size and type; don't mix old and new.
reviewers.source: Energizer: Battery care do's and don'ts

reviewers.point: Turn off all light strings and decorations before leaving home or going to bed.
reviewers.source: NFPA: Winter Holiday Safety tip sheet

pros: Battery powered, no 220V cord
Pom-poms add soft, textile texture
Pink and white suit candy or blush corners
cons: 20 LEDs: a soft accent rather than a main light
Runs on batteries, so keep spares handy
items.bestFor: A soft, playful glow on a shelf, headboard or window
items.tip: Drape it in loose swoops behind the nutcrackers. Use fresh batteries of one brand and take them out after the season.

sections.name: Filipino Christmas (capiz and parols)
sections.alt: AI sample render of a small condo corner styled in the Filipino Christmas (capiz and parols) theme with the picks below
sections.definition: A Filipino Christmas corner decorates with the country's own materials: a glowing capiz parol, woven rattan or abaca, and handwoven cloth on the Noche Buena table. Keep the base neutral so the shell's glow and the fibres' texture do the decorating.
tips: Hang the parol on the wall, not the floor: Federal Land suggests a parol on the wall as a condo space-saver, and it frames the whole corner.

Use two or three native materials and repeat them. CITEM describes Philippine design as natural, endemic materials like abaca, buri, bamboo and rattan in earth tones, so let capiz, rattan and handwoven cloth carry the look.
Plug-in capiz pieces need a PS mark or ICC sticker, one socket each (no 'octopus' wiring), and switching off at bedtime (Meralco, BFP).

items.label: Best capiz
items.name: JSC Special Capiz Parol, 18 in (LED)
items.verdict: The classic Pampanga capiz star: real shell panes glowing in bold colours, from a shop named for Pampanga capiz parols.
items.summary: Capiz is a thin, translucent shell, so light comes through it soft and jewel-toned. This 18-inch star layers red, green, blue and yellow capiz petals around a red centre, outlined in LEDs. It comes in 220V for home, or 110V for family abroad.

reviewers.point: Parols were traditionally made of bamboo and Japanese paper; modern ones also use plastic, metal and capiz shell.
reviewers.source: Wikipedia: Parol

reviewers.point: Capiz is the shell of the windowpane oyster. It has long been used as a glass substitute because it is durable and lets light through.
reviewers.source: Wikipedia: Windowpane oyster (capiz)

reviewers.point: Meralco advises using only Christmas lights with a PS mark or ICC sticker, and unplugging lights and lanterns before bed or when leaving home.
reviewers.source: Interaksyon (Philstar): Meralco holiday electrical safety tips (23 Dec 2022)

pros: Real capiz shell panes in a classic star shape
From a store named for Pampanga capiz parols
220V for home, or 110V to send abroad
cons: PS mark or ICC sticker not shown; ask the seller first
Plug-in, so hang it near an outlet
items.bestFor: The main parol of the house, on a sala wall or inside a big window
items.tip: Before checkout, ask the seller for a photo of the PS mark or ICC sticker on the lights. Choose 220V, use a sturdy hook and unplug it at bedtime.

items.label: Best Pinoy touch
items.name: Localimade Abaca Parols with Tails, Set of 2 (8 x 11 in)
items.verdict: A pair of handmade abaca parols in red and green: the Filipino Christmas symbol, with no cord and no floor space.
items.summary: Condo guides suggest a parol on the wall instead of more on the floor. These handmade abaca parols have the classic crescent, star and tails, and need no power. Hang the red one in front of the curtain lights so it glows, and the green one on the door.

reviewers.point: Federal Land suggests decorating the walls to save floor space, including installing a parol on a wall.
reviewers.source: Federal Land Knowledge Hub: 11 Christmas Decoration Ideas for Condo Spaces (Dec 2021)

reviewers.point: The parol is 'an iconic symbol of Filipino Christmas', and its most common form is a five-pointed star with two tails.
reviewers.source: Wikipedia: Parol

reviewers.point: Abaca is a banana species native to the Philippines, and its fibre is woven into handicrafts.
reviewers.source: Wikipedia: Abacá

pros: Handmade abaca: natural fibre, not plastic
No cord, so it hangs anywhere
Two parols per order, in palette colours
cons: Unlit, so pair it with fairy or curtain lights
Compact (8 x 11 in), sized for windows and doors
items.bestFor: The window (in front of the curtain lights) and the inside of the unit door
items.tip: Choose red and green to match the set. Hang them with clear thread from adhesive hooks, and keep them away from the stove and hot bulbs.

items.label: The woven tree
items.name: Quezon Handicrafts Slim Rattan Christmas Tree, 4 ft
items.verdict: A slim, hand-woven rattan cone that reads as a Christmas tree and as Filipino craft at the same time.
items.summary: Instead of a plastic pine, this corner uses a native tree: an open diamond weave of natural rattan in a slim 4 ft cone, with a wire star on top. Its narrow shape suits a condo corner, and the weave throws soft patterns when the capiz lamp is lit.

reviewers.point: Rattan is a group of climbing palms used for handicrafts like baskets, furniture and decorative art, valued for being light, durable and somewhat flexible.
reviewers.source: Wikipedia: Rattan

reviewers.point: CITEM notes that 'almost every community has their own woven cloth and pattern, carried through generations of weavers'.
reviewers.source: CITEM: The Big Business of Small Objects (24 Jun 2025)

reviewers.point: Common-sense care: keep it away from damp walls and the stove, dust it with a dry brush, and store it wrapped in cloth.

pros: Hand-woven natural rattan, not plastic
Slim 4 ft cone fits a condo corner
From a named Quezon handicraft store
cons: About 4 ft tall, made to stand on the floor
Check if the balls and rings shown are included
items.bestFor: An empty sala corner beside the console or under the parol
items.tip: Hang three or five mini abaca stars on it, or wind in a warm-white USB string. Confirm with the seller what is included.

items.label: The Noche Buena table
items.name: Arkus Balay Pinilian Handwoven Table Runner
items.verdict: A handwoven pinilian runner turns the Noche Buena table into the Filipino part of the corner, and it works all year.
items.summary: Pinilian is a brocade technique of Ilocos inabel weaving, and a runner is the easiest way to bring it home. This one is handwoven in small diamond patterns; the photo shows cream, mustard, rust and brown colourways. Lay it under the Noche Buena spread.

reviewers.point: Inabel is a patterned cotton textile from the Ilocos Region, and pinilian, a brocade weave, is one of its design techniques.
reviewers.source: Wikipedia: Inabel

reviewers.point: CITEM notes that 'almost every community has their own woven cloth and pattern, carried through generations of weavers'.
reviewers.source: CITEM: The Big Business of Small Objects (24 Jun 2025)

reviewers.point: Common-sense care: wipe spills right away, hand-wash cold, and dry it flat in the shade so the colours last.

pros: Handwoven pinilian pattern (per listing title)
Works as a table or bed runner
Earthy colours suit capiz and rattan
cons: The splurge of this corner, and it works all year
Several colourways; confirm yours with the seller
items.bestFor: The Noche Buena table or a console under the capiz lamp
items.tip: Choose a cream-and-rust colourway to tie the parol red to the rattan. Put a heat mat under hot dishes to protect the weave.
